ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question:
1) Who wrote the following lines :
''Drive my dead thoughts over the universe
Like wither'd leaves to quicken a new birth!''?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Will take from both a deep, autumnal tone,
Sweet though in sadness. Be thou, Spirit fierce,
My spirit! Be thou me, impetuous one!

Drive my dead thoughts over the universe
Like wither'd leaves to quicken a new birth!
And, by the incantation of this verse.

Ode to the West Wind
By P. B Shelley.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 2) The play 'Salome' is written by-
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Oscar Wilde’s one-act play Salomé (published 1893; first performed 1896) was translated by Hedwig Lachmann.
Oscar Wilde was an Irish poet, novelist and dramatist.
His famous books are The Importance of Being Earnest, A woman of No Importance, An Ideal Husband, The Picture of Dorian Gray, Lady Windermere's Fan etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman and Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 3) ‘Horatio’ is a character from
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Characters of William Shakespeare's tragedy ‘Hamlet’ are:
Hamlet, Horatio, Ophelia, Claudius etc.
Source: Britannica

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 4) The literature of _____ era was preceded by romanticism and was followed by Modernism.
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Victorian Period হল Romantic Period আর Modern Period-এর মধ্যবর্তী যুগ।
Romantic Period - এর সাহিত্যিক বৈশিষ্ঠ্য থাকার পাশাপাশি এই যুগের সাহিত্যকর্মে আধুনিক যুগের অনেক বৈশিষ্ঠ্যও ছিল লক্ষ্মণীয়।
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 5) Allegory has -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option1: ক) a surface story with another story hidden underneath.
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option3: গ) a tradition of being performed orally.
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Allegory: (রূপক বর্ণনা; প্রতীকাশ্রয়ী কাহিনী)
A literary form in which one story is told in the guise of another story.
Ex: Bunyan's Pilgrim's Progress
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 6) Which one is the example of alliteration?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Alliteration (noun):
Meaning: The occurrence of the same letter or sound at the beginning of adjacent or closely connected words.
Bengali meaning: অনুপ্রাস।
প্রশ্নে শুধু অপশন ক) - তে অনুপ্রাস রয়েছে।

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 7) Which one is an example of Oxymoron?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
পরস্পরবিরোধী দুটি অর্থ একসাথে মিলে একটি অর্থ প্রকাশ করলে সেটি oxymoron-এর উদাহরণ।
এখানে Sweet Sorrow পরস্পরবিরোধী শব্দের মাধ্যমে একটি অর্থ প্রকাশ পেয়েছে।

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 8) “Sense and Sensibility” is written by
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Jane Austen -এর লেখা উপন্যাসগুলো হলঃ
- Pride and Prejudice,
- Sense and Sensibility
- Emma. ইত্যাদি।
তাকে রোমান্টিক যুগের এন্টি-রোমান্টিক লেখক বলা হয়।

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 9) ‘Godfrey’ is a character from -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Silas Marner, in full Silas Marner: The Weaver of Raveloe, novel by George Eliot, published in 1861.
The story’s title character is a friendless weaver who cares only for his cache of gold. He is ultimately redeemed through his love for Eppie, an abandoned golden-haired baby girl, whom he discovers shortly after he is robbed and rears as his own child.
Other characters:
Dunstan, Godfrey, Nancy, Molly etc.
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 10) Doctor Faustus is a -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Christopher Marlowe is a writer from the Elizabethan period. He is a university wit.
His famous literary works are-
- Tamburlaine the Great Part I & II;
- The Jew of Malta;
- Edward II;
- Doctor Faustus.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 11) Find the odd one out:
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
William Shakespeare is an Elizabethan Period’s writer. Moreover, He is mainly a dramatist.
William Wordsworth, Lord Byron and William Blake - সবাই রোমান্টিক যুগের লেখক।

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 12) John Donne is -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Metaphysical poet, any of the poets in 17th-century England who inclined to the personal and intellectual complexity and concentration that is displayed in the poetry of John Donne, the chief of the Metaphysicals.
Other Metaphysical poets are:
- Henry Vaughan,
- Andrew Marvell,
- John Cleveland,
- Abraham Cowley
- George Herbert and
- Richard Crashaw.
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 13) Which of the following writers belong to the Romantic Period?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp: John Keats, Lord Byron, S T Coleridge, William Blake, William Wordsworth, P B Shelly -রা রোমান্টিক কবি বলে পরিচিত।

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 14) “Cruelty has a Human Heart, And Jealousy a Human Face”- is a famous line from-
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
“Cruelty has a Human Heart
And Jealousy a Human Face
Terror the Human Form Divine
And Secrecy, the Human Dress
The Human Dress, is forged Iron
The Human Form, a fiery Forge.
The Human Face, a Furnace seal'd
The Human Heart, its hungry Gorge.”

A Divine Image
By William Blake.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 15) Find the odd-man-out:
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp: T. S Eliot Modern Poet। বাকি তিনজনই Victorian Poet

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 16) ‘Playboy of the Western World’ is-
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option4: ঘ) a theatrical adaptation of a poem
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The Playboy of the Western World, comedy in three acts by J.M. Synge, published and produced in 1907. It is a masterpiece of the Irish literary renaissance.
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 17) George Orwell wrote -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option2: খ) Down and Out in Paris and London
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option3: গ) The Road to Wigan Pier
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
George Orwell এর আসল নাম হলো Eric Arthur Blair. তিনি ব্রিটিশ ভারতে জন্মগ্রহণ করেন।
Animal Farm এবং Nineteen Eighty-Four (1984) জর্জ অরওয়েলের দুটি বিখ্যাত উপন্যাস।

Works:
Novel:
- Animal Farm (1945 – a fairy story)
- Nineteen Eighty-Four
- Burmese Days
- Coming up for Air.
Other works:
- Shooting an Elephant
- Down and Out in Paris and London
- The Road to Wigan Pier

Source: Encyclopedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 18) “I fall upon the thorns of life! I bleed!”- written by
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp: এই লাইনটা Shelley-এর Ode to the West Wind কবিতা থেকে নেওয়া।

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 19) Who does not belong to the Renaissance age?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
রবার্ট ব্রাউনিং Victorian Period - এর অন্যতম কবি। তাই, এটি সঠিক উত্তর।
William Shakespeare, Christopher Marlowe, Ben Johnson - Renaissance Period - এর Literary Figure।

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 20) Desdemona’s handkerchief has the -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
ওথেলো নাটকে ওথেলো ডেসডিমোনাকে একটি রুমাল দেয়। রুমালটি হারিয়ে যাওয়া নিয়ে নাটকে অনেক ঘটনা ঘটেছে।
এই রুমালের গায়ে স্ট্রবেরির ডিজাইন ছিল, যেটি ভার্জিন ব্লাড দিয়ে ডাই করা।

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 21) “Samson Agonistes” is a literary work of -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Samson Agonistes, (Greek: “Samson the Athlete” or “Samson the Wrestler”) tragedy by John Milton, published in the same volume as his epic Paradise Regained in 1671.
It is considered the greatest English drama based on the Greek model and is known as a closet tragedy (one more suited for reading than performance).

John Milton is called Epic Poet. He is also called 'A great master of verse in the Puritan Period'.
His famous epics are Paradise Lost and Paradise Regained.

Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 22) The Introduction of comic scenes in a serious work is called:
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
ট্র্যাজেডির দুঃখময়, সিরিয়াস আবহে একটু আনন্দ বা হাসির জন্য দু’একটা কমিক সংলাপ, চরিত্র বা দৃশ্যের অবতারণা করা হয়। এগুলোই কমিক রিলিফ বলে পরিচিত।
From the Oxford Dictionary:
Comic Relief: humorous content in a dramatic or literary work intended to offset more serious episodes.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 23) Tetrameter has -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Iambic tetrameter is, next to iambic pentameter, the most common metre in English poetry;
It is used in the English and Scottish traditional ballads, which are usually composed of four-line stanzas of alternating iambic tetrameter and trimeter.
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 24) Who is a Fabian Socialist?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Fabian Society, a socialist society founded in 1884 in London, having as its goal the establishment of a democratic socialist state in Great Britain.
The Fabians put their faith in evolutionary socialism rather than in revolution.
It's founding is attributed to Thomas Davidson, a Scottish philosopher, and its early members included George Bernard Shaw, Sidney Webb, Annie Besant, Edward Pease, and Graham Wallas.
Shaw and Webb, later joined by Webb’s wife, Beatrice, were the outstanding leaders of the society for many years.
In 1889 the society published its best-known tract, Fabian Essays in Socialism, edited by Shaw.

Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 25) ‘Novum Organum’ is written by
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Francis Bacon is called a natural philosopher. He is also called the Father of English Essay and Father of Modern Prose.
His famous works are Novum Organum, Essays, Divine and Humane, Advancement of Learning, The Wisdom of Ancients and The New Atlantis etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 26) A passing reference to a literary or historical person, place, or event or to another literary work or passage is called-
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Allusion:
An implicit or indirect reference to another work of literature, a historical or mythical person or event.
Example:
''Not half so fixed the Trojan could remain,
While Anna begged and Dido raged in vain'' is an example of allusion.
(Pope: The Rape of the Lock)

Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 27) ‘To Daffodils’ is written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The Daffodils is written by - William Wordsworth.
To Daffodils is written by Robert Herrick

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 28) Who wrote “Biographia Literaria”?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Biographia Literaria is a famous work by Samuel Taylor Coleridge, published in two volumes in 1817.
S.T Coleridge is an English lyrical poet, critic, and philosopher.
His Lyrical Ballads, written with William Wordsworth, heralded the English Romantic movement, and his Biographia Literaria (1817) is the most significant work of general literary criticism produced in the English Romantic period.
His other notable works:
- “The Rime of the Ancient Mariner”
- “Christabel”
- “Kubla Khan”
- “Frost at Midnight”
- “Dejection: An Ode”
- “On the Constitution of the Church and State”
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 29) ‘Ulysses’ by Alfred Tennyson is a:
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Ulysses, a blank-verse poem by Alfred, Lord Tennyson, written in 1833 and published in the two-volume collection Poems (1842).
In a stirring dramatic monologue, the aged title character outlines his plans to abandon his dreary kingdom of Ithaca to reclaim lost glory in a final adventure on the seas.
(Dramatic monologue একধরণের লিরিক কবিতা যেটিতে শুধু একজন বক্তা পুরো বক্তব্যটি বলে যান। যদি অন্য কোন শ্রোতা সেই বক্তার সামনে থেকেও থাকে, তবু সেই শ্রোতাকে কথা বলতে দেখা যায় না। আমরা শুধু কবিতার স্পিকারের মুখ থেকেই সমস্ত কিছু জানতে পারি।)

Dramatic monologue, a poem written in the form of a speech of an individual character; it compresses into a single vivid scene a narrative sense of the speaker’s history and psychological insight into his character. Robert Browning is mostly famous for Dramatic monologue.

Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 30) 30) In which year, W. B Yeats received Nobel Prize in Literature?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
William Butler Yeats (1865 – 1939):
- Irish dramatist, poet, and critic.
- He is famous for his use of “Symbolism and Mysticism”.
- He wrote the preamble of Tagore's “Gitanjali” in 1912, which later got Nobel prize in 1913.
- W.B Yeats got the Nobel prize in 1923.

Major Works:
Famous Books of Poems:
- The Wild Swans at Coole,
- The Tower,
- The Cat and the Moon.
Poems:
- The Winding Stair and Other poems,
- The Resurrection,
- The Second Coming,
- Byzantium,
- The Lake Isle of Innisfree,
- Among School Children,
- The Lord of Harts,
- A Prayer for My Daughter,
- When You Are Old.
Drama:
- The Countess Cathleen,
- Cathleen in Houlihan.
‘The Countess Cathleen’ verse drama by William Butler Yeats, published in 1892 and performed in 1899.

Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 31) Who introduced 'objective correlatives'?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Objective correlative, a literary theory first set forth by T.S. Eliot in the essay “Hamlet and His Problems” and published in The Sacred Wood (1920).
T.S. Eliot used this phrase to describe “a set of objects, a situation, a chain of events which shall be the formula of that particular emotion” that the poet feels and hopes to evoke in the reader.
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 32) The Postmodern era started -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
ইংরেজি সাহিত্যে Modern Period শুরু হয় ১৯০১ সালে রাণি ভিক্টোরিয়ার মৃত্যুর পর পরই এবং তা শেষ হয় ১৯৩৯ সালে যখন দ্বিতীয় বিশ্বযুদ্ধ শুরু হয়।
তখন থেকেই Postmodern period শুরুর সময় ধরা হলে যুদ্ধচলাকালীন তেমন উল্লেখযোগ্য সাহিত্যকর্ম রচিত হয় নি।
তাই মূলত ২য় বিশ্বযুদ্ধের পর থেকেই Post-modern period-এর সূচনা হয়।
Source: A Glossary of Literary Terms by M. H. Abrams.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 33) 'Arms and the Man' is a -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Arms and the Man, a romantic comedy in three acts by George Bernard Shaw, produced in 1894 and published in 1898.
The play is set in the Petkoff household in Bulgaria and satirizes romantic ideas concerning war and heroism.
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 34) The span from 1798-1832 is known as -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
সাহিত্যে মূলত: এই রোমান্টিক ধারাটি শুরু হয়েছিল Coleridge এবং Wordsworth-এর Lyrical ballads-এর প্রকাশনা দিয়ে।
কোথাও রোমান্টিক পিরিয়ডের সময়কাল ১৭৮৯-১৮৩২; কোথাও আবার ১৭৯৮-১৮৩২।
M. H. Abrams-এর A Glossary of Literary Terms অনুযায়ী, সময়কাল ১৭৮৫-১৮৩০।
তবে, সবচেয়ে গ্রহনযোগ্য সময়কাল - ১৭৯৮ থেকে ১৮৩২ সাল পর্যন্ত।

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 39) ''The Countess Cathleen'' is written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The Countess Cathleen, verse drama by William Butler Yeats, published in 1892 and performed in 1899.
Like many of Yeats’s plays, The Countess Cathleen was inspired by Irish folklore.
In a time of famine, demons sent by Satan come to Ireland to buy the souls of the starving people. The saintly Cathleen disposes of her vast estates and wealth in order to feed the peasants, yet the demons thwart her at every turn; at last, she sacrifices her own soul to save those of the poor.
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 40) “A play on words that are either identical in sound or very similar in sound, but are sharply diverse in meaning” is -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Pun, also called paronomasia, humorous use of a word in such a way as to suggest different meanings or applications, or a play on words, as in the use of the word rings in the following nursery rhyme:

Ride a cock-horse to Banbury Cross,
To see a fine lady upon a white horse;
Rings on her fingers and bells on her toes,
She shall have music wherever she goes.

অর্থ্যাৎ, Pun হল একই ধরণের উচ্চারণের একটি শব্দের ভিন্ন ধরণের অর্থ নিয়ে খেলা।

Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 41) 'Aspects of the Novel' is written by
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Aspects of the Novel, collection of literary lectures by E.M. Forster, published in 1927.
- For the purposes of his study, Forster defines the novel as “any fictitious prose work over 50,000 words.”
- He employs the term aspects because its vague, unscientific nature suits what he calls the “spongy” form in question.
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 42) The background of the story of ''A Tale of Two Cities'' is -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
A Tale of Two Cities, a novel by Charles Dickens, published both serially and in book form in 1859.
The story is set in the late 18th century against the background of the French Revolution.
Although Dickens borrowed from Thomas Carlyle’s history, The French Revolution, for his sprawling tale of London and revolutionary Paris, the novel offers more drama than accuracy.
The scenes of large-scale mob violence are especially vivid, if superficial in historical understanding.
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: ৪৩) The story of the famous novel ''For Whom the Bell Tolls'' written by Ernest Hemingway is set in -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
For Whom the Bell Tolls, a novel by Ernest Hemingway, published in 1940.
The title is from a sermon by John Donne containing the famous words "No man is an island, entire of itself; every man is a piece of the Continent, a part of the main…. Any man’s death diminishes me, for I am involved in mankind. Any therefore never send to know for whom the bell tolls; it tolls for thee."

SUMMARY:
The novel is set near Segovia, Spain, in 1937 and tells the story of American teacher Robert Jordan, who has joined the anti-fascist Loyalist army.
Jordan has been sent to make contact with a guerrilla band and blow up a bridge to advance a Loyalist offensive. The action takes place during Jordan’s 72 hours at the guerrilla camp. During this period he falls in love with María, who has been raped by fascist soldiers and befriends the shrewd but cowardly guerrilla leader Pablo and his courageous wife, Pilar.
Jordan manages to destroy the bridge; Pablo, Pilar, María, and two other guerrillas escape, but Jordan is injured. Proclaiming his love to María once more, he awaits the fascist troops and certain death.
Set in 1937 during the Spanish Civil War, For Whom the Bell Tolls follows the struggles of an American college instructor who has left his job to fight for the Republicans.
Robert Jordan has been dispatched from Madrid to lead a band of guerrillas that operates in a perpetual state of a leadership crisis.

Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 45) ___________ is a literary device in which ultimately virtue is rewarded and viciousness is punished.
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:

The term was coined by the English literary critic Thomas Rymer in the 17th century when it was believed that a work of literature should uphold moral principles and instruct the reader in correct moral behaviour.
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 49) Who is known as 'Lake Poet' in English Literature?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Lake poet, any of the English poets William Wordsworth, Samuel Taylor Coleridge, and Robert Southey, who lived in the English Lake District of Cumberland and Westmorland (now Cumbria) at the beginning of the 19th century.
- They were first described derogatorily as the “Lake School” by Francis (afterwards Lord) Jeffrey in The Edinburgh Review in August 1817, and the description “Lakers” was also used in a similar spirit by the poet Lord Byron.
- These names confusingly group Wordsworth and Coleridge together with Southey, who did not subscribe in his views or work to their theories of poetry.
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 59) 'Vladimir' and 'Estragon' are the two characters from -

Waiting for Godot, a tragicomedy in two acts by Irish writer Samuel Beckett, published in 1952.
It was a true innovation in drama and the Theatre of the Absurd’s first theatrical success.

The play consists of conversations between Vladimir and Estragon, who are waiting for the arrival of the mysterious Godot, who continually sends word that he will appear but who never does. They encounter Lucky and Pozzo, they discuss their miseries and their lots in life, they consider hanging themselves, and yet they wait.

The Duchess of Malfi tells the story of the spirited duchess and her love for her trustworthy steward Antonio. They marry secretly, despite the opposition of her two brothers, Ferdinand (the Duke of Calabria) and the Cardinal. Although she bears three children, she refuses to name the father.

Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 73) Who became a poet laureate in Britain?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Poet laureate:
Poet laureate, title first granted in England in the 17th century for poetic excellence.
Its holder is a salaried member of the British royal household, but the post has come to be free of specific poetic duties. In the United States, a similar position was created in 1936.
Notable Poet laureates:
- Ben Jonson
- Sir William Davenant
- Robert Southey
- William Wordsworth
- Alfred Tennyson

Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 74) Which of the following is not a figure of speech?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp: Novel ছাড়া বাকি সবই Figure of Speech।

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 75) Commonwealth Period of English Literature refers to -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Elizabethan age- 1558-1603, Caroline Age- 1625-1649, Jacobean Age-1603-1625 এবং Commonwealth Period হল 1649-1660
Source: A Glossary of Literary Terms by M. H. Abrams

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 76) Which poem is known as a vision in a dream by Coleridge?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option1: ক) The Rime of the Ancient Mariner
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Kubla Khan, a Vision in a Dream, poetic fragment by Samuel Taylor Coleridge, published in 1816.
- According to Coleridge, he composed the 54-line work while under the influence of laudanum, a form of opium.
- Coleridge believed that several hundred lines of the poem had come to him in a dream, but he was able to remember only this fragment after waking.
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 77) ''A unified plot should have a beginning, middle and end.''- Who said this?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp: অ্যারিস্টটল তার Poetics-এ প্লট ব্যাখ্যা করতে গিয়ে কথাটি বলেছেন।

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 78) The Faerie Queene is a poem written by-
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp: Edmund Spenser-এর লেখা একটি Epic poem হল The Faerie Queen

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 79) 'Vanity Fair' is a novel written by–
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Vanity Fair, a novel of early 19th-century English society by William Makepeace Thackeray, published serially in monthly instalments from 1847 to 1848 and in book form in 1848.
He also wrote - The Virginians.
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 80) 'Alexander Pope' belongs to -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Alexander Pope, (born May 21, 1688, London, England—died May 30, 1744, Twickenham, near London), poet and satirist of the English Augustan period.
He is best known for his mock-heroic poetry.
Some of his famous works are:
- The Rape of the Lock (1712–14),
- The Dunciad (1728), and
- An Essay on Man (1733–34).
He is one of the most epigrammatic of all English authors.

Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 81) Which one is written by Virginia Woolf?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.option3: গ) A Room with a View
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Virginia Woolf was a female novelist. She is famous for presenting inner realities.
Her famous novels are:
- The Voyage Out (first novel)
- To The Lighthouse
- Mrs. Dalloway
- A Room of One's Own
- The Waves, etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature.

- A Room with a View is a novel written by E. M Foster.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 82) The book, 'Lyrical Ballads' was published in-
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Lyrical Ballads হল William Wordsworth এবং S. T Coleridge - এর প্রকাশিত একটি বই যা প্রকাশ হয় ১৭৯৮ সালে।
এই বই প্রকাশের মাধ্যমে English Literature এ Romantic Period এর শুরু হয়।

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 83) Who is the Father of English prose?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
John Wycliffe (1324 – 1384):
- Father of English prose.
- Translated Bible / New Testament into English prose.
Alfred the Great is being called the founder of English prose.
Geoffrey Chaucer: Father of Modern English poetry.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 84) The reign of Charles I is known as
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp: Caroline শব্দটি এসেছে Carolus থেকে । এটি Charles-এর নামের Latin version। 1625-49 এই সময়কালকে ইংরেজি সাহিত্যে The Caroline Age নামে পরিচিত।

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 85) 'The Unfortunate Traveller' written by Thomas Nashe is a/an -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The Unfortunate Traveller; or, The Life of Jacke Wilton is a novel written by Thomas Nashe.
The novel is a brutal and realistic tale of adventure narrated with speed and economy. The book describes the travels through Germany and Italy of its rogue hero, Jacke Wilton, who lives by his wits and witnesses all sorts of historic events before he is converted to a better way of life.
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 86) The line, ''And death shall be no more; Death, thou shalt die.'' is an example of-
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp: আপাতদৃষ্টিত অবাস্তব মনে হলেও যে কথার মধ্য দিয়ে সত্য প্রকাশ পায়, সেটিই Paradox. এখানে বলা হচ্ছে যে, মৃত্যু মারা যাবে, এটি আপাতদৃষ্টিতে সম্ভব নয়। তাই, এটি Paradox।

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 87) 'War and Peace' is masterpiece novel written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
War and Peace, a historical novel by Leo Tolstoy, originally published as Voyna I mir in 1865–69.
This panoramic study of early 19th-century Russian society, noted for its mastery of realistic detail and variety of psychological analysis, is generally regarded as a masterwork of Russian literature and one of the world’s greatest novels.
Other Literary works:
- “Anna Karenina”
- “The Death of Ivan Ilyich”
- “Resurrection”
- “Kholstomer”
- “The Cossacks”
- “Sevastopol in May”
- “What I Believe”
- “Sevastopol in December”
- “The Kingdom of God Is Within You”
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 88) 'The Pilgrim's Progress' is a famous allegory in prose written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The Pilgrim’s Progress, a religious allegory by the English writer John Bunyan, published in two parts in 1678 and 1684.
The work is a symbolic vision of the good man’s pilgrimage through life. At one time second only to the Bible in popularity, The Pilgrim’s Progress is the most famous Christian allegory still in print.
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 89) Haiku is a -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Haiku, an unrhymed poetic form consisting of 17 syllables arranged in three lines of 5, 7, and 5 syllables respectively.
The haiku first emerged in Japanese literature during the 17th century, as a terse reaction to elaborate poetic traditions, though it did not become known by the name haiku until the 19th century.
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 90) 'Persuasion' is a novel written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Persuasion, a novel by Jane Austen, published posthumously in 1817.
Her other works:
- “Emma”
-  Mansfield Park
- “Pride and Prejudice”
- “Sense and Sensibility”
- “Northanger Abbey”
- “Persuasion”
- “Mansfield Park”
- “Lady Susan”

Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 91) 'To Kill a Mockingbird' is written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
To Kill a Mockingbird, a novel by Harper Lee, published in 1960.
Enormously popular, it was translated into some 40 languages and sold more than 30 million copies worldwide.
In 1961 it won a Pulitzer Prize. The novel was praised for its sensitive treatment of a child’s awakening to racism and prejudice in the American South.
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 92) 'The Jew of Malta' is written by:
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp: Christopher Marlowe শেক্সপীয়রের যুগের একজন নাট্যতার। The Jew of Malta তার একটি বিখ্যাত নাটক।

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 93) “A Defence of Poetry” is a literary work of -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
P. B Shelly was an English Romantic poet whose passionate search for personal love and social justice was gradually channelled from overt actions into poems that rank with the greatest in the English language.
His famous literary works are:
- Prometheus Unbound (1820),
- A Defense of Poetry (1820),
- Ode to the West Wind,
- To a skylark,
- The Revolt of Islam,
- Alastor,
- Ozymandias,
- Queen Mab,
- The Cloud.
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 94) 'The Scholar Gipsy' is a poem written by -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
The Scholar Gipsy, a lyric poem by Matthew Arnold, published in Poems (1853).
It is a masterful handling of the 10-line stanza that John Keats used in many of his odes.
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 95) 'Willy Loman' is protagonist of -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
Death of a Salesman, a play in “two acts and a requiem” by Arthur Miller, written in 1948 and produced in 1949.
Miller won a Pulitzer Prize for the work, which he described as “the tragedy of a man who gave his life, or sold it” in pursuit of the American Dream.

After many years on the road as a travelling salesman, Willy Loman realizes he has been a failure as a father and a husband.
His sons, Happy and Biff, are not successful—on his terms (being “well-liked”) or any others. His career fading, Willy escapes into dreamy reminiscences of an idealized past.
In the play’s climactic scene, Biff prepares to leave home, starts arguing with Willy, confesses that he has spent three months in jail, and mocks his father’s belief in “a smile and a shoeshine.” Willy, bitter and broken, his illusions shattered, commits suicide.

Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 96) Renaissance means -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp: Renaissance একটি ফরাসি শব্দ যার অর্থ Rebirth.

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 97) Geoffrey Chaucer wrote -
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:

The outstanding English poet before Shakespeare.
His 'The Canterbury Tales' ranks as one of the greatest poetic works in English.

- 'The Friar’s Tale',

- 'The Clerk’s Tale',
- 'The Man of Law’s Tale',
- 'The Franklin’s Tale'.

Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp: এটি Satan চরিত্রের বলা একটি লাইন। Paradise Lost কাব্য থেকে নেওয়া।

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 99) 'My Last Duchess' by Robert Browning is a famous-
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
My Last Duchess, a poem of 56 lines in rhyming couplets by Robert Browning, published in 1842 in Dramatic Lyrics, a volume in his Bells and Pomegranates series.
It is one of Browning’s most successful dramatic monologues.

- “Paracelsus”
Source: Britannica.com

ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.question: 100) Who is not a university wit?
ইংরেজি সাহিত্য সম্পূর্ণ.exp:
University Wits:
Elizabethan Period - এর একদল নাট্যকার (Dramatist) - কে একত্রে University Wits বলা হয়।
এই নাট্যকারদের প্রায় সবাই Oxford বা Cambridge University এর গ্রাজুয়েট।
তারা তাদের লেখনীতে গতানুগতিক ধারা পরিহার করে বৈচিত্র্য ও সমসাময়িক আধুনিকতা আনায়ন করেন।

University Wits - রা হচ্ছেনঃ
1. Christopher Marlowe - (Cambridge)
2. Robert Greene - (Cambridge)
3. Thomas Nashe - (Cambridge)
4. Thomas Lodge - (Oxford)
5. George Peele- (Oxford)
6. John Lyly - (Oxford)
7. Thomas Kyd (not university-trained)

Shakespeare - University Wit নয়।

Source: Britannica.com
